title: Putter Read The Green Trust The Stroke (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 128bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl acoustic guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, putting is half the game
Read the green, trust the stroke, never the same
Eighteen holes, eighteen putts is the dream

[Verse 1]
Eyes directly over the ball, plumb bob the line
Feet shoulder width narrow, weight fifty fifty fine
Ball position off the lead eye, hands hang natural
Grip light as feathers, son, putting is gentle

[Pre-Chorus]
Pendulum stroke from the shoulders, son
No wrist break, no flip, the work undone
Back and through, equal length, equal pace
Let the stroke breathe, never race

[Chorus]
Putter read the green, trust the stroke
Shoulders rock, hands stay broke
Speed is king, son, line is queen
Die it at the hole, smoothest you have seen

[Verse 2]
Lag putts focus on speed, get it inside three feet
Short putts focus on line, find the dead center seat
Uphill firm, downhill soft, sidehill read the slope
Grain of the green, son, gives the ball its hope

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, never decelerate the putter
Accelerate through the ball, smooth as butter
If you slow down at impact, the face wobbles
Push through, son, no putt hobbles

[Chorus]
Putter read the green, trust the stroke
Shoulders rock, hands stay broke
Speed is king, son, line is queen
Die it at the hole, smoothest you have seen

[Outro]
Speed first, line second
Pendulum smooth, son, beckoned
Eighteen putts a round, thats the goal
Thats my boy, thats your soul
